description: make example EX=axi_lite: AXI4-Lite master + register slave (axi_lite_tb.sv). Hand-written: views, channel groups, bookmarks and arrows; the Makefile passes the dump with --waves.

page.title: AXI4-Lite · one write, one read
page.intro: The master writes 0x1234ABCD to 0x08 (address, then data, then the response; the slave raises AWREADY a cycle late) and reads it back. Signals are grouped by channel, one colour per channel (groupColors); the write channels open highlighted (Esc clears it).

handshakes.title: AXI4-Lite · handshakes · clock-sampled
handshakes.note: a bookmark on every VALID & READY cycle; the arrows give the latency between the channels

bookmarks.text: AW handshake: address 0x08 accepted (AWREADY came a cycle after AWVALID)
W handshake: data 0x1234ABCD, all four strobes
